method: Streamed every listed repo default-branch tarball from codeload.github.com and byte-matched each text file (.ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.cjs/.json/.yml/.yaml/.md/.vue/.svelte/.toml/.txt, extensionless) under 2 MB; node_modules and .git skipped; 200 MB / 300 s per-repo cap.

Excluded from counts: lockfiles, docs (.md, docs/), tests (tests/, *.spec.*, *.test.*, fixtures), .github/, comment lines, and copies of dsh's own files (path suffix of 4+ segments matching a harness path at any dsh-v* tag, or a shorter match in a repo holding 5+ such copies).

Every cited line re-opened off raw.githubusercontent.com at HEAD: 4008 of 4011 still match; the 3 that moved are in PerryLink/dsh-doublecheck and PerryLink/dsh-auto-review (files edited since the scan).
npm side: registry.npmjs.org/<name>/latest for every registry npm name.

Subpath display: for every package whose bundle patch names a subpath of itself, resolved <spec>/package.json, <spec>/locale/en.json and <spec>/icon with Node exports rules (exact key, single-* patterns, conditions node/import/module-sync/default) against the npm latest tarball when the row has an npm name, else the repo HEAD.
GitHub REST code search used as a recall check only (legacy index, 1000-result cap; 52 queries, see code_search_recall).

blind_spots: Default branch only; other branches and unpushed work are invisible.
889 listed repos returned 404 from codeload (deleted, private, or renamed) and 27 were cut at 200 MB / 300 s.
Only text extensions listed in method were read; .sh, .py, .patch are not loaded by dsh but were skipped.
npm side read only each package's latest manifest, plus tarballs for the subpath surface; older published versions still installed in profiles are not counted.
Whether a bundle row loads is decided at runtime by profile composition; outcomes are verified for dsh-feishu-bot only, the rest are inferred from source and the gate.
